title: False-positive guard: noisy real manager
persona: Priya, finance executive at Kaveri Textiles
description: A real warehouse manager on a noisy 8 kHz line asks for a routine payment to a known vendor at a normal amount. Friction must stay minimal.

segments.text: Hi Priya, Suresh here from the warehouse.
The monthly packaging invoice from Mehta Packaging is due.
Please release ₹42,000 as usual through NEFT, same account as last month.
segments.tts: Please release forty two thousand rupees as usual through NEFT, same account as last month.
